title: Claim
description: An atomic claim extracted from the report. claim_id = sha256(section_id + sentence_text)[:16].

claim_type.description: Only factual claims hard-fail on lack of support

cited_source_ids.description: Stable source_ids cited for this claim

evidence_ids.description: Evidence rows that support this claim

extraction_id.description: Timestamp of the extract_claims.py extract run that appended this row; the same for every row of one run. Rows of the latest extraction_id are the current report (citation-order numbering reads only those). Absent on rows added by hand with extract_claims.py add.

doc_position.description: 1-based position of the claim sentence in document order within its extraction run.

_citation_numbers.description: Working field: the [N] numbers the sentence cited when extracted, resolved to cited_source_ids by verify_claim_support.py link through the run's display_numbers.json.

_support_score.description: Working field: token-overlap support score written by verify_claim_support.py verify when evidence quotes are linked.

_support_notes.description: Working field: the reason verify_claim_support.py verify gave for the score.
